items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: And him and George Orton, I played together. Viola and violin.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was a, him and I was back east. I was a violin player. And him and George Orton, I played together. Viola and violin.
Did he play a four-string banjo ever? Or do you remember?
